_source: Google Sheet 'WO Board and Tech View – questions for Chris Ward (14 Oct 2026)', https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gBGmNB4B1bRrD2ZJvBn1tuvbfxFPjcsKddz_I5H3CvU, tab 'Questions for Chris', column E 'Your answer', read 15 Oct 2026. Answers copied verbatim.
12: 12. Changed ruling: the filter chips and Search use the design file's icons in every display option, List included, each exactly as the design file draws it. This is the only change to List. New wording in Goals and S1-R9a.
13: 13. (a). Sideways scrolling is fine, as in the design; columns keep the design's minimum widths and are never squeezed or clipped. S2-R22. The "runs off the right edge" line in SV-11317 was about the old 14 List columns and is not a defect on its own.
14: 14. (a). Unit and Assigned Techs. List columns keep the List's labels. S5-R4.
15: 15. (b). 16px at Compact and Regular, 22px at Comfortable, as the design draws it. The PRD's 18px came from an unused badge in the design system and is corrected in S6-R2a. SV-11318 needs updating to 16px.
16: 16. (a). PRD v53 S9-R1a: technician group-header grips show to everyone who can reorder technicians, view-only users included; row grips show only to users with Work Orders create and edit; the Unassigned header has no grip. SV-11320 needs updating to match.
17: 17. (a). The magnifier, the same as List (S1-N1). The clipboard icon is only for a view with no work orders at all. S1-R9a.
18: 18. (a). The same values show at every density, and there is no hours line under the progress bar at any density. S2-R20, S6-R6.
19: 19. (a). Test the dialog as drawn (search, avatars, N open per technician, no grouping), plus Unassigned as its first row. The design is final for this release. S4-R12.
20: 20. (a), made exact: while you scroll through an expanded group, its header stays just under the column headings. Only one header is held at a time; the next group's header pushes it off. Unassigned works the same way. S2-E1, S2-R18.
21: 21. (a). Today's tabs, toolbar and Create Work Order button stay. The only changes to the page are the switcher and the chip and Search icons (Q12).
22: 22. (a). Board cards use the List's production pill with the red and blue counts, 22px tall. New S3-R5a.
23: 23. (a). Every technician name in both views, avatar hover names included, is the staff record name. S5-R11b.
24: 24. (a). The tooltips read List, Tech View and Board View. S1-R9b.
25: 25. Neither (a) nor (b): as in the design, Status, Number and Customer are always shown in Tech View and can't be turned off; every other column, Unit included, can be. New S5-R4a.
26: 26. (b). Leave it out of this release; it's in Out of Scope.
27: 27. (a). Row and card text is 14px at every density, and Compact never shrinks it. Text the design sets at 12px at every density (column header labels, the percentage, secondary lines) stays 12px. S6-R4.
28: 28. (a). Yes to both. Tab reaches every control, Enter opens, Escape closes, and focus returns to the control that opened a menu or dialog. Reassigning by keyboard goes through the ⋯ menu. There is no keyboard drag, so reordering is by mouse or touch only (Out of Scope). Story 11 is rewritten.
29: 29. (a). Test both views in the dark theme as well as light, with the design file's dark colors. New S1-R9c.
30: 30. (a), tightened: sideways comes back exactly. Vertically, the row or card that was at the top comes back at the top, fully shown, within one row or card. S1-R8.
31: 31. (a). The same as the List: the first technician's full name, then +N, with every name on hover. The List doesn't change. S5-R11.
